programs.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Kellogg's Cereals"
programs.desc: In Kellogg’s first factory in Europe, built in the 1930s in Trafford Park, Manchester, we meet the people who flake the corn and puff the rice, the tasters who test, and the robots and hi-tech machines that help keep the boxes rolling out day and night.

programs.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Explosions"
programs.desc: Ultimate Explosions chronicles the compelling stories of explosions that have reverberated around the world.

programs.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Fighter Pilots"
programs.desc: New pilots train in air‑to‑air combat at an international exercise, mastering dogfighting and modern fighter jet technology.

programs.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Paratroopers"
programs.desc: Airborne troops train as force multipliers, learning how paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to seize targets and launch ambushes.

programs.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Combat Medics"
programs.desc: Combat medics risk it all to save soldiers under fire. We join their training to see what it takes to save lives in the field.

programs.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Basic Training"
programs.desc: Basic training transforms civilians into soldiers, sailors, and airmen through intense physical and psychological tests.
